spark-docling-cpu: Up Less than a second

observation.command:
cd /tmp
# Start docling per the guide
docker run -d --name spark-docling-cpu \
  -p 5001:5001 \
  -e DOCLING_NUM_THREADS=4 \
  -e OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 \
  -e DOCLING_SERVE_ENABLE_UI=1 \
  -e DOCLING_SERVE_MAX_DOCUMENT_TIMEOUT=3600 \
  -e DOCLING_SERVE_MAX_SYNC_WAIT=3600 \
  -e DOCLING_SERVE_LOAD_MODELS_AT_BOOT=True \
  quay.io/docling-project/docling-serve-cpu:latest 2>&1 | tail -2
docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}" | grep docling
